prompt: Release an open-source Python library: documentation, versioning and changelog, CI, dependency audit, tests, review of outside contributions, API decisions and the launch announcement.

subtasks.query: write the README and usage documentation for a Python library
set up semantic versioning, changelog and release notes
GitHub Actions CI that runs tests and builds packages
review pull requests from outside contributors
audit the dependencies for known vulnerabilities
unit tests and coverage for the public API
decide the public API surface and deprecation policy
announce the release on social media and in a newsletter

prompt: Build a sales KPI dashboard for leadership: define the metrics, pull CRM data into a warehouse, write the queries, forecast next quarter, find rep-level coaching opportunities and summarise the findings.

subtasks.query: define the sales KPIs and their formulas
build the data pipeline from the CRM into a warehouse
design the dashboard layout and charts for executives
forecast next quarter revenue from pipeline data
SQL queries for win rate and sales cycle time
find rep-level performance outliers and coaching opportunities
one-page summary of findings for the leadership team

prompt: Build a patient appointment booking app for a clinic group: clinical rules, HIPAA review, accessible mobile and web screens, scheduling backend, patient messages, user research and compliant marketing copy.

subtasks.query: clinical evidence review for the triage rules
HIPAA and patient privacy compliance review
accessible booking screens for patients with disabilities
mobile app for patients on iOS and Android
scheduling backend with provider availability
appointment reminder and patient support messages
user interviews with patients and clinic staff
marketing claims compliance for the clinic website

prompt: Build a customer support chatbot for a SaaS product: retrieval over help articles, prompt and tool design, evaluation, human escalation, knowledge graph of features, cost monitoring and red-team testing.

subtasks.query: retrieval pipeline over the help center articles
write and tune the chatbot system prompt and tool instructions
evaluate chatbot answer quality with a test set
escalation rules and handoff to human agents
knowledge graph of product features and their relationships
monitor the cost and latency of model calls in production
red-team the chatbot for prompt injection
